3f9fb69be3b0.title: Student Assistance - Procurment
3f9fb69be3b0.description_md:
**Join us to Make an Impact**

Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Join Our Team as  **Student Assistance - Procurment.**

Put your studies into practice as a Student Assistant in our Procurement team. Gain hands-on experience with data analysis, suppliers, and procurement processes while supporting an international organization.

**Your role and responsibilities**

* **Procurement excellence:** Support improvements to procurement processes, procedures, templates, workflows, and reporting.
* **Indirect procurement:** Support sourcing activities by collecting quotations, comparing offers, and following up with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* **Data and insights:** Prepare reports, analyse data, and identify spending patterns, data gaps, and improvement opportunities.
* **Procurement master data:** Collect, maintain, and validate supplier, contract, and purchasing data, including questionnaires, certificates, and supplier records.
* **Team support:** Assist the Procurement team with supplier documentation, follow-up activities, and other operational tasks as needed.

**What you bring to the team**

* **Relevant studies:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree within supply chain, business, economics, or a related field.
* **Analytical mindset:** Comfortable working with data and turning it into useful insights.
* **Digital skills:** Comfortable with Excel and interested in developing Power BI skills. ERP experience is an advantage.
* **Working style:** Proactive, curious, and comfortable taking ownership while collaborating with others.
* **Communication:** Confident written and spoken English

**What you will gain**

Develop your analytical and coordination skills alongside experienced colleagues. Gain practical procurement and supplier experience in an international environment - a strong foundation for your future career.

### **Keep your personal data safe**

### Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

### You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

### Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

### Thank you.

ac52a095b9c9.title: Red Barnet søger praktikant til rekruttering og employer branding
ac52a095b9c9.description_md:
Træd ind i en verden af HR, og lad din teoretiske viden blomstre i en praktikrolle, hvor du får ansvaret for en masse spændende opgaver.

Hos Red Barnet er vi løbende på udkig efter praktikanter, der vil være med til at drive vores rekrutteringsindsats og styrke vores employer branding.

Er du klar til at omsætte dine akademiske kompetencer til praksis og tage udfordringen op i en selvstændig og berigende rolle? Ansøg nu og vær med til at skabe en positiv indvirkning på verdens børn og din egen professionelle udvikling.

**"***Min praktikperiode hos Red Barnet har åbnet døre til en verden af spændende udfordringer inde for HR. Det har ikke kun givet mig indsigt**i min fremtidige karriere, men også beriget mit studie med en dybdegående og yderst relevant erfaring.”* – Julie, tidligere employer branding og rekrutteringspraktikant.

**Arbejdsopgaver**

**Rekruttering**, herunder telefonisk screening af kandidater, assistere med koordineringen og afviklingen af jobsamtaler samt udvælgelse af kvalificerede kandidater

**Kommunikation**, herunder undersøge og bidrage med nyt indhold til vores rekrutteringsplatforme, f.eks. udformning af jobopslag

**Annoncering**, herunder annoncering af opslag, tracking af kampagner på SoMe og andre rekrutteringsplatforme

**Medarbejderfastholdelse**, herunder implementering af fastholdelsesinitiativer, f.eks. udformning af exit surveys, afvikling af sociale arrangementer m.m.

**Administrative- og ad-hoc opgaver**, herunder besvarelse af e-mails, udarbejdelse af månedsrapport samt onboarding og offboarding flows

**VI KAN TILBYDE DIG**

* En mulighed for at afprøve din teoretiske viden i praksis
* En praktikplads med fokus på udvikling og ansvar fra din første dag
* Et bredt indblik i diverse HR-processer med særligt fokus på rekruttering
* Indblik i en arbejdsplads der hver dag arbejder for verdens mest udsatte børn
* Et fleksibelt praktikforløb hvor timeantal og praktiklængden fastlægges i forhold til dit studie og eventuelle studiejob

**Om dig**

* Vi forstiller os, at du læser en videregående uddannelse der kan relatere sig til de relevante arbejdsopgaver. Dette kunne f.eks. være noget indenfor HR, kommunikation, administration, psykologi eller lignende
* Arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt
* Er ansvarsbevidst og proaktiv
* Derudover skal du bare være frisk på at lære en masse nye ting og få en masse spændende arbejdsopgaver

Forventet opstart: Vi søger praktikanter til hhv. forår/sommer/efterår/vinter 2027.

Vi indkalder løbende kandidater til samtale og afslutter rekrutteringsprocessen, når den rette kandidat er fundet. Da vi løbende søger rekrutteringspraktikanter, er du meget velkommen til at sende os en ansøgning uagtet af, hvornår din praktikperiode starter. 
 

**SPØRGSMÅL & KONTAKTINFORMATIONER**

Hvis du har spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Coordinator Mie Larsen (mila@redbarnet.dk) eller Head of Acquisition Harald Kildsig (hki@redbarnet.dk).

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

05f20d545da2.title: Intern – Palestine
05f20d545da2.description_md:
We are seeking a motivated and committed intern to support our advocacy work on Palestine and joint advocacy campaigns. The internship offers an opportunity to contribute to human rights-based advocacy related to Palestine, working closely with our advocacy team.

The intern will support research, trends analysis, coordination, communications, and project management tasks, contributing to campaigns and policy engagement at the global level.

**Key responsibilities**

* Support advocacy, policy and research work related to Palestine, including trends analysis and background research
* Contribute to campaign, messaging and policy development
* Assist with research for reports, briefing notes, and advocacy tools
* Support day-to-day project management, including planning and preparation of meetings, workshops, and events
* Assist engagement and coalition-building efforts with civil society networks and partners across European capitals
* Support communications, press, social media, and campaign activities to maximise visibility and outreach
* Contribute to monitoring, evaluation, and learning activities
* Proofreading, light translation, and other ad-hoc administrative tasks as needed

**Required qualifications and skills**

* Knowledge of the context in Palestine and Israel, including the latest political and humanitarian developments
* Proficiency in English, both written and spoken
* Analytical skills, with the ability to synthesise complex information
* Ability to use social media platforms for communications, and campaigns
* Experience with document-sharing platforms (e.g. Google Drive, SharePoint) and project management tools (e.g. Trello or similar)
* Organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
* Attention to detail, particularly in writing, editing, and proofreading
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in an international team

**Desired assets**

* Background in international relations, political science, international law, human rights, development studies, or related fields
* Familiarity with civil society organisations and public campaigns
* Experience supporting communications or advocacy activities

**Personal qualities**

* Interest in human rights and international advocacy
* Cultural sensitivity and ability to work in sensitive contexts
* Proactive, flexible, and willing to learn

**What we offer**

* Hands-on experience in international advocacy and policy work
* Exposure to joint advocacy campaigns
* A collaborative and international working environment at DCA’s HQ
* Working space at our HQ and IT equipment
* Free access to DCA’s canteen and lunch scheme

**Location:** Copenhagen (DCA HQ)
**Duration:** 1 February 2027 – 30 June 2027
**Department:** DCA Palestine
**Reports to:** International Coordinator

Please note: This internship is unpaid and must be undertaken as part of an ongoing university curriculum, based on a framework agreement with a university institution.

Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and a brief cover letter by **Friday, 14 November**. Interviews are scheduled to take place between 23–27 November. Only applications that meet the above requirements will be considered, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

We encourage applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of age, gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or ethnic background. For further information regarding DCA, please visit our website at: <https://www.danchurchaid.org/>

9ee910feaa93.title: Global Public Affairs Intern – European & Nordic Policy (Early Careers)
9ee910feaa93.description_md:
Are you studying political science, economics or business, and do you want to understand how politics, regulation and geopolitics shape one of the world’s largest integrated logistics companies? As Global Public Affairs Intern at Maersk, you will join our Europe team, with a particular focus on the Nordic countries, and work on live political issues alongside colleagues who advise senior management and engage with governments, authorities and industry organisations.

**Key Responsibilities**

As an intern in Global Public Affairs, you will work where Maersk’s business priorities meet politics, regulation and geopolitics. We support all parts of the business on political issues, and the team has a global remit.

You will contribute to tasks such as:

* Monitoring and analysing political and legislative developments in the EU, Denmark, Sweden and the wider Nordic region, and assessing what they mean for Maersk’s business.
* Preparing briefs and background material for senior executives ahead of meetings with ministers, officials and other stakeholders.
* Conducting desk research and analysis on topics such as societal security and preparedness, critical infrastructure, supply chain resilience and trade policy.
* Contributing to positions and consultation responses on policy issues.
* Supporting the planning of stakeholder meetings, delegation visits, seminars and other external engagements.
* Taking on a defined project of your own during the internship, with responsibility for delivering it from start to finish.

Join us in this exciting role where you will make a significant impact on Maersk’s global engagements and strategic initiatives, driving forward our mission to connect and simplify our customers’ supply chains while leading the way in sustainable practices.

**Why Choose Maersk?**

By joining Maersk, you’re becoming a part of a pioneering force in integrated logistics, dedicated to improving the quality of life of people by integrating the world. Our Global Public Affairs team is at the forefront of shaping the dialogue on global integration, leveraging our expansive network to champion initiatives that drive meaningful change. As an intern, you’ll gain unparalleled insights into the mechanics of global trade and the strategic considerations of a leading multinational and support our climate-journey towards net-zero. As Intern at Maersk, you will also become part of our international student network full of activities and events.

**Who We’re Searching For**

We are looking for a structured and detail-oriented student with a genuine interest in how business and politics interact. You are pursuing a master’s degree or are in the final year of your bachelor’s degree, in political science, economics, business or another relevant field at a Danish University based out of Copenhagen, Denmark.

You:

* Can turn political and business issues into clear, concise analysis and written material.
* Work in a structured way and with strong attention to detail, also when deadlines are tight.
* Take ownership of your tasks and see them through to delivery.
* Speak and write Danish or Swedish at a professional level, and are fluent in English.
* Are proficient in PowerPoint and Excel.

The internship is a full-time position (37 hours/week) at our Copenhagen headquarters from January to [June/July] 2027. We are, however, flexible to accommodate potential scheduling conflicts and your university credit transfer requirements.

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

 

We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing  [accommodationrequests@maersk.com](mailto:accommodationrequests@maersk.com).

d1c87ed3527d.title: Student til at understøtte DI's projekter i udviklings- og vækstøkonomier
d1c87ed3527d.location: DI København - Industriens Hus H. C. Andersens Blvd. 18 1553 København Denmark DI København - Industriens Hus H. C. Andersens Blvd. 18 1553 København Denmark København
d1c87ed3527d.description_md:
Er du interesseret i global udvikling og danske virksomheders engagement på vækstmarkeder? Og har du lyst til at blive en del af det udviklingspolitiske projektarbejde i Danmarks største erhvervsorganisation? Dansk Industris afdeling for Emerging Markets søger en ambitiøs og selvstændig studentermedhjælper til at understøtte samarbejdet med erhvervsorganisationer i Asien, Afrika, Latinamerika og Europas naboskabsregion.  

**Om os**
DI spiller en central rolle i det danske udviklingssamarbejde. I Emerging Markets arbejder vi med DI’s udviklingspolitik gennem samarbejde med erhvervs- og arbejdsgiverorganisationer i vækst- og udviklingsøkonomier. Vores projekter, drevet i samarbejde med den danske fagbevægelse, sætter fokus på grøn omstilling, jobskabelse, uddannelse samt bedre vilkår for virksomheder og arbejdstagere i samarbejde. Vi samarbejder tæt med relevante ministerier, civilsamfundsaktører og fonde for at styrke danske virksomheders tilstedeværelse i udviklings- og vækstøkonomier.

Som student i Emerging Markets bliver du en del af et internationalt, engageret team som brænder for at skabe positive forandringer. Vi tilbyder en alsidig hverdag og et stærkt netværk af studenter og kolleger i hele DI. 
 
**Dine arbejdsopgaver**

Som student i Emerging Markets får du mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer inden for projektimplementering og global udvikling. Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være at:

* Understøtte vores projektarbejde i udviklings- og vækstøkonomier i samarbejde med afdelingens konsulenter.

* Bidrage til at understøtte projektarbejdet via research, notater og analyser på emner i udviklings- og vækstøkonomier

* Forberede præsentationer til konsulenter i afdelingen.

* Støtte op om planlægning og afholdelse af arrangementer og delegationsbesøg i Danmark med deltagelse af vores globale partnere.

* Hjælpe med ad hoc-opgaver i tæt samarbejde med kolleger i både Danmark og på vores internationale kontorer i Vietnam og Kenya.

**Om dig**

Vi forestiller os, at du:

* Er bachelorstuderende på mindst 2. år eller kandidatstuderende (med mindst 1,5 år tilbage)

* Skriver og taler fejlfrit på dansk og engelsk. Kendskab til andre sprog – herunder særligt fransk, spansk eller arabisk er en fordel.

* Har interesse for – og gerne erfaring med – projektunderstøttelse, global udvikling og privat erhvervsliv.

* Er analytisk og metodisk stærk og nysgerrig på at forstå komplekse sammenhænge.

* Er dygtig til at arbejde både kvalitativt og kvantitativt.

* Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og er ikke bange for at tage initiativ.

* Trives i et åbent og levende arbejdsmiljø med plads til idéer og ansvar.

**Det praktiske**

Vi bor i Industriens Hus på Rådhuspladsen i København og arbejder så vidt muligt fra kontoret.

I Emerging Markets har vi, foruden dig, tre andre dygtige studenter, der alle spiller en vigtig rolle for, at vi kan lykkes med vores arbejde. Du bliver samtidig en del af DI’s store studenternetværk og får fleksible rammer, så studie og arbejde kan hænge sammen.  
 
Arbejdstiden er ca. 15 timer pr. uge. Der vil være mulighed for international rejseaktivitet i forbindelse med projekter.

**Sådan søger du**

Send din ansøgning (max. 1 side), CV og karakterudskrift via ansøgningslinket senest den 27. november 2026.

Samtaler vil blive afholdt den 3. december (indkaldelse den 1. december) og anden samtaler den 7. december.  

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte fagleder Clara Halvorsen på [clha@di.dk](mailto:clha@di.dk).  

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

34c35c075c58.title: Studentermedhjælpere med stærke AI-kompetencer og interesse for advokatbranchen
34c35c075c58.description_md:
**Jobbet**
Hos Accura har vi en klar ambition: Vi skal være det førende advokathus i Norden på brugen af AI. Som studentermedhjælper skal du være med til at realisere denne ambition. Vi tror på, at fremtidens juridiske rådgivning opstår i krydsfeltet mellem stærk juridisk faglighed, kommerciel forståelse og intelligent anvendelse af teknologi.

Du bliver enten tilknyttet et juridisk team eller vores nyoprettede AI-afdeling – afhængigt af dine kompetencer og interesser. Uanset placering får du indblik i, hvordan en advokatvirksomhed fungerer i praksis, og mulighed for at arbejde tæt sammen med dygtige kolleger. Du bliver desuden en del af Accuras studentergruppe, som du kommer til at lære bedre at kende gennem sociale og faglige arrangementer.

**Din arbejdsdag**
Vi tilbyder fleksibilitet i forhold til planlægningen af dine arbejdsdage, så arbejdstiden kan tilpasses dine studieaktiviteter. Dine opgaver kan bl.a. være at:

* identificere muligheder for at optimere juridiske opgaver og arbejdsgange
* udvikle og afprøve AI-use cases, AI-agenter og automatiserede workflows og at arbejde med prompt engineering
* foretage informationssøgninger og systematisere viden
* udarbejde analyser, oplæg og andet materiale
* understøtte juridiske teams med andre relevante opgaver.

**Vi forestiller os, at du**

* har stærke AI-kompetencer og motiveres af at omsætte dem til praktiske løsninger
* er interesseret i advokatbranchen og har lyst til at forstå juridisk arbejde
* er nysgerrig af natur og har øje for, hvordan opgaver og arbejdsgange kan optimeres
* er studerende på en videregående uddannelse inden for jura, erhvervsjura, IT eller et andet relevant område – f.eks. på KU, DTU, CBS eller ITU
* er dygtig til skriftlig fremstilling og mundtlig kommunikation på både dansk og engelsk
* er en holdspiller, der gerne vil bidrage til fællesskabet.

**Hvad tilbyder vi?**
Accura tilbyder et fleksibelt og udviklende job på 15 timer om ugen i en dedikeret erhvervsadvokatvirksomhed med godt 475 medarbejdere.

Vi tilbyder attraktive løn- og ansættelsesvilkår, herunder overtidsbetaling, obligatorisk pensionsordning og sundhedsordning. Vi prioriterer din udvikling højt, og du får blandt andet mulighed for at deltage i kurser på Accuras interne uddannelsesforløb Accura Academy. Læs mere om, hvordan vi investerer i dig som studerende på vores [studenterunivers](javascript:void(0)).

Du får din base i vores domicil i Nordhavn, som byder på moderne og inspirerende rammer med metrostationen Orientkaj lige uden for døren.

**Hvad gør du nu?**
Send en ansøgning hurtigst muligt via linket i denne stillingsannonce, og vedhæft dit CV, dine eksamensbeviser og karakterer. I din ansøgning vil vi gerne høre mere om, hvilke erfaringer du har med at anvende AI og hvorfor du gerne vil arbejde med AI hos Accura.
Vi afholder løbende samtaler. Hvis du har spørgsmål vedrørende stillingen, er du velkommen til at ringe til HR business partner Olga Kristiane Lydert Wittenborg på +45 3945 0576.

8826ee192da9.title: Studerende til weekendarbejde i stort køkken hos Københavns Madservice i Brønshøj
8826ee192da9.description_md:
# Studerende til weekendarbejde i stort køkken hos Københavns Madservice i Brønshøj

## Søg jobbet

Område:

Drift og service

Ansøgningsfrist:

13.11.2026

Arbejdstid:

Deltid - alt under 37 timer

Jobtype:

Fastansættelse

[Søg jobbet](https://candidate.hr-manager.net/ApplicationInit.aspx?cid=1518&ProjectId=217139&DepartmentId=20124&MediaId=5&SkipAdvertisement=true)

**Vi søger en frisk og engageret medarbejder, der er klar på spændende opgaver i et stort køkken i weekender, helligdage og ferier.**

I weekendteamet har vi brug for en ny kollega fra den 1. december 2026 til at indgå i fast vagt hver 4. weekend. Teamet dækker forskellige opgaver, heriblandt pakning af færdigpakket mad, som dagligt skal distribueres til borgere, plejehjem og bosteder i Københavns Kommune. Teamet varetager også forskellige kontoropgaver, telefonbetjening af chauffører og kunder samt lettere opvask. Weekendteamet består af fire forskellige hold, hvor der altid er tre medarbejdere, der arbejder sammen om opgaverne.

Du har desuden mulighed for at få ekstra vagter i helligdags- og ferieperioderne.

Københavns Madservice (KMS) er et stort produktionskøkken, hvor vi på hverdage producerer ca. 1600 portioner veltillavet mad. Vi følger Københavns Kommunes økologi- og klimadagsorden og laver mad af gode råvarer, som vi tilbereder til danske klassikere og mere moderne retter.

**Jobbet**
Arbejdet består af rutinemæssige opgaver, som skal udføres på samme måde hver dag. Vi er ambitiøse og derfor er omhyggelighed, orden og systematik vigtige faktorer i det daglige arbejde. En stor del af dagen foregår pakkearbejdet i kølerum, hvor I er to kollegaer, der arbejder sammen. Alle i teamet er en del af det samlede KMS. Vi anerkender samarbejde på tværs og prioriterer et godt arbejdsmiljø, socialt samvær og udviser respekt for hinanden.

**Kvalifikationer**

* Vi ønsker en kollega, som hurtigt skaber overblik og trives med systematik i arbejdet
* Vi søger en kollega, der er imødekommende og glad for at arbejde sammen med andre
* Vi kommunikerer både skriftligt og mundtligt – det er derfor vigtigt, at du er god til dansk
* Vi ønsker en kollega, som hjælper, hvor der er brug for det – I KMS hjælper vi alle hinanden
* Vi forventer, du har kendskab til Office-pakken, og det er en fordel, hvis du desuden har kendskab til produktionsstyringssystemet Master Cater System (MCS)
* Det er nødvendigt at tale og forstå dansk, da du samarbejder med mange både via skrift, i telefon eller i dialogen i køkkenet, hvor dansk er jeres fælles sprog

**Det kan du glæde dig til**

* En arbejdsplads, som stiller krav til kvalitet i arbejdet – vi gør os umage
* At blive en del af et fællesskab, hvor vi møder hinanden med et smil og godt må være begejstrede
* At arbejde i et team og en organisation, hvor vi kontinuerligt arbejder med god trivsel i dagligdagen – både i eget team og på tværs af KMS
* Er du studerende inden for sundhed og ernæring, vil du få et fagligt relevant studiejob

**Ansættelsesvilkår**
Løn og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

Det er en fastansættelse med arbejde hver 4. weekend. Arbejdstiden i weekender og helligdage er i tidsrummet kl. 6.30-14.00. Opstart den 1. december 2026.

**Vil du vide mere?**
Kontakt Lotte Meyer Fovsholm på 38 27 42 62 for yderligere spørgsmål.

Vores køkken er beliggende i Bystævneparken 15, 2700 Brønshøj.

**Søg via linket senest fredag den 13. november 2026**

**Om Sundheds- og Omsorgsforvaltningen**
Vores hverdag handler om mennesker. Se mere om vores hverdag på [www.vores-hverdag.kk.dk](http://www.vores-hverdag.kk.dk).

## Jobagent

Du kan oprette en jobagent, så du modtager en mail når Københavns Kommune opslår et job med netop din interesse.

[Opret en jobagent](https://candidate.hr-manager.net/Agent/Subscription.aspx?customer=kkdk)

## Mangfoldighed

I Københavns Kommune arbejder vi for at gøre livet i København endnu bedre. Det giver vores hverdag mening, og mulighederne er mange.

Københavns Kommune arbejder aktivt med ligestilling og inklusion og ser mangfoldighed som en styrke for organisationen. Vores arbejdspladser skal afspejle den diversitet, der kendetegner byen, og som alle medarbejdere bidrager til med deres særlige baggrund, personlighed og evner.

d34896ce6f49.title: Student assistant interested in turning data and insights into actions
d34896ce6f49.description_md:
Would you like to help strengthen climate adaptation across the Nordic region? Join Tryg’s Climate Excellence team as a student assistant and help turn data into insights that support better decisions.

**About the job | A student job that creates value**

You will join the newly established Climate Excellence team, part of Tryg’s Insurance Technical Group Function. The function drives technical excellence and data-driven decision-making across the Nordic business to support Tryg’s long-term competitiveness.

The goal of Climate Excellence is to help Tryg better understand and respond to climate risks, supporting smarter decisions for both the business and our customers.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Collecting, structuring, and visualizing data and information for analysis
* Exploring trends across multiple data sources and translating findings into practical recommendations
* Preparing presentations and decision-support material for colleagues and management
* Supporting projects and initiatives related to climate adaptation and resilience

You will gain insight into how data, insurance, climate adaptation, and business strategy come together in practice while developing analytical and communication skills in a Nordic organization.

The role is based in Ballerup and involves collaboration with colleagues in Denmark, Sweden, and Norway. We occasionally meet as a Nordic team in Bergen or Stockholm, approximately once a month. Participation is optional, and online attendance is always possible.

**About you | Curious, collaborative, and interested in working with data**

You are currently enrolled in a relevant higher education programme, such as business, economics, engineering, technology, mathematics, data science, climate studies, or a related field. Ideally, you have at least two years remaining in your studies.

You enjoy working with both quantitative and qualitative information, identifying patterns, and presenting insights in a clear and structured way. You are curious about developments in society and motivated by learning through varied tasks and collaborations.

The following skills will help you succeed in the role:

* Experience using Excel to structure and analyze data
* Experience using PowerPoint to communicate insights and recommendations
* An interest in data analysis and tools such as Python
* Strong written and spoken English skills

You do not need to meet every criterion to apply. We are primarily looking for someone with curiosity, motivation, and the willingness to learn. Danish language skills are an advantage but not a requirement.

The position is approximately 15 hours per week, and your working hours will be planned flexibly around your studies and exam periods.

**About us | Personal and professional development**

Climate Excellence works across Tryg’s Nordic business to develop and standardize climate-related initiatives and strengthen climate knowledge throughout the organization.

You will join a small Nordic team with backgrounds in climate, analytics, insurance, and business development. We collaborate closely across countries and functions and believe the best solutions are created through teamwork, knowledge sharing, and diverse perspectives.

We offer:

* Meaningful tasks with real business impact
* A supportive environment with responsibility and guidance
* Flexible working arrangements that accommodate your studies
* Opportunities for personal and professional development
* A strong professional and social community

**We look forward to hearing from you**

We welcome applications from students of all backgrounds and value different perspectives. We focus on skills, motivation, and potential, and strive to provide an inclusive recruitment process and working environment. We encourage you **not** to attach a photo to your CV.

We recommend sending the application as soon as possible as we are holding interviews continuously.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Business Analyst Oliver Christensen at: oliver.c@tryg.dk

**Application deadline: 15 November 2026**.

daa87a30954f.title: Praktikant hos Söderberg & Partners
daa87a30954f.description_md:
**Vil du være praktikant hos de bedste - og blive en af dem?**

Vil du have praktikpladsen, der booster dit CV, bygger dit netværk og giver dig direkte adgang til virkeligheden i en stor, handlingsorienteret organisation? Så er det hos Söderberg & Partners, du skal være!

**Hvem er vi?**

Söderberg & Partners er en af Nordens førende forsikrings- og pensionsmæglere med over 4.400 medarbejdere globalt og tilstedeværelse i flere europæiske lande, herunder 8-10 kontorer i Europa. I Danmark beskæftiger koncernen omkring 500 medarbejdere fordelt på ca. 23 kontorer.

**Hvorfor blive en del af os?**
Hos os er du ikke bare “praktikant” - du er en del af holdet fra dag ét. Vi lever af at skræddersy løsninger til vores kunder, og det gælder også for vores praktikanter. Vi tilpasser praktikforløbet, så det passer til dine kompetencer, interesser og ambitioner, så du får mest muligt ud af din tid hos os.

Du bliver tilknyttet en mentor, der guider dig hele vejen: fra forsikringsfaglige spørgsmål og praktikrapporten til sparring om din karrierevej. Samtidig bliver du en vigtig del af vores sociale fællesskab, hvor vi løfter hinanden - både fagligt og menneskeligt.

**Det bliver du en del af:**

* **Reelle kundemøder:** Du deltager aktivt og lærer, hvordan man sætter sig ind i kunders behov - og følger op med forsikringsselskaberne.
* **Markedskonkurrence:** Du lærer at samle og sende kundens behov til markedets største aktører.
* **Skadeshåndtering:** Du tager ansvar for, at skadesanmeldelser når de rette modtagere - hurtigt og korrekt.
* **Eget ansvar:** Få chancen for at drive din egen kundeportefølje - med erfarne kolleger, der altid er klar til at hjælpe dig, når du har brug for sparring.

**Hvem er du?**
Vi vil høre fra dig, der:

* **Er modig** - tør påtage dig opgaver, du ikke har prøvet før.
* **Er ansvarlig** - du følger dine opgaver helt til dørs og står på mål for kvaliteten.
* **Er hjælpsom** - du deler gerne din energi og viden med andre og ved, at stærke resultater skabes sammen.
* **Er empatisk** - du kan sætte dig i andres sted og skabe tryghed for både kunder og kolleger.
* **Har drive & nysgerrighed** - du tænker i nye løsninger og vil hele tiden udvikle dig.

**Hvad lover vi dig?**
Vi lever efter løfterne om at være:

* **Åbne** - vi spiller med åbne kort over for kunder, kolleger og dig som praktikant.
* **Analytiske** - vi bygger beslutninger på data, viden og indsigt.
* **Personlige** - vi møder kunder og kolleger som mennesker, ikke bare roller.

Vi lover dig et praktikforløb, hvor ansvarlighed og hjælpsomhed ikke bare er ord – men en del af hverdagen. Og fordi vi skræddersyer forløbet til dig, bliver din tid hos os både lærerig og meningsfuld.

Og vigtigst af alt - viser du engagement og tager ansvar, har vi en stærk tradition for at fortsætte samarbejdet efter praktikopholdet - noget, mange af vores tidligere praktikanter allerede har haft glæde af.

**Klar til at tage springet?**
Send os din ansøgning - og fortæl, hvordan du vil bidrage til vores værdier og kundeløfter. Til gengæld lover vi, at du får et praktikophold, der ikke kun styrker dit CV, men også viser dig, hvad du virkelig kan udrette.

Har du spørgsmål - eller bare lyst til at høre mere om os? Ring til Growth Manager Ümid Ghadimi på 28 15 07 96 - han glæder sig til at tage en snak med dig.

18554b8c9317.title: Student Worker | Business Intelligence & Data Analytics
18554b8c9317.description_md:
***Vi søger*** ***en datastærk og analytisk studentermedhjælper*** ***med*** ***interesse for Business Intelligence og dataanalyse******, som*** ***vil være med til at omsætte data til indsigt i vores analyseløsninger til den*** ***offentlige*** ***sektor******.***

**Om stillingen**

Som studentermedhjælper i AI & Business Analytics bliver du en del af et team af erfarne forretningsfolk og IT-udviklere med en bred vifte af kompetencer. Afdelingen drifter og udvikler fem applikationer, og du vil arbejde med vores AI-baserede analysesystemer inden for indkøbsanalyse og CO2-beregning. Du kommer til at arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem forretning og teknologi med fokus på datakvalitet, ML-kategorisering og dataanalyse.

I starten hjælper du med de løbende dataopgaver, som vores kunder efterspørger. Efterhånden som du lærer løsningerne at kende, kan du blive involveret i udviklingsprojekter inden for Business Intelligence, Data Analytics eller Data Engineering afhængigt af dine interesser og kompetencer. Platformene bygger på MS Azure og Power BI, og vi benytter AI/ML på tværs af løsningerne.

**Det kommer du til at arbejde med:**

* Bearbejde, validere og analysere data med afsæt i kundernes og markedets behov
* Udvikle og tilpasse datamodellen i samarbejde med udviklerteamet
* Udarbejde værdifulde BI-rapporter for og med kunderne
* Undersøge og forbedre datakvaliteten i vores løsninger
* Vurdere og forbedre kategorisering af indkøbsdata og dermed understøtte vores ML-model
* Bidrage til AI- og analyseprojekter, der understøtter konkrete forretningsbehov
* Indgå i dialog med kunderne og understøtte dem i at analysere deres indkøbsmønstre og den tilhørende CO2-udledning
* Deltage i teammøder og teamdage

**Det får du af os:**

* Mulighed for at omsætte din viden fra studiet til praksis inden for Business Intelligence, dataanalyse og evt. AI
* Praktisk erfaring med datakvalitet, databehandling og forretningsnære analyseløsninger i tæt samarbejde med den offentlige sektor i Danmark, Norge og Sverige.
* Faglig sparring med erfarne kolleger inden for forretning og IT samt mulighed for at udvikle dig i en mere analytisk eller datateknisk retning
* Et fleksibelt arbejdsmiljø med mulighed for at kombinere studier med arbejde

**Vi forestiller os, at du:**

* Du er på sidste år af en relevant bacheloruddannelse, fx HA (almen), HA (mat) eller lignende, eller er netop startet på en relevant kandidatuddannelse, fx cand.merc. med fokus på Business Intelligence. Du kan også have en studieretning inden for Data Analytics eller Data Engineering
* Du interesserer dig for sammenhængen mellem data, teknologi og forretning. Kendskab til Power BI / DAX, SQL eller Python er en fordel, men du behøver ikke kunne det hele på forhånd
* Du arbejder analytisk og struktureret, har sans for detaljer og er nysgerrig på at lære nye værktøjer og forstå komplekse data
* Du er kommunikativ og har gode samarbejdsevner. Vores team sidder spredt i Ballerup, Aalborg, Århus og Warszawa.
* Du kan arbejde selvstændigt og trives i et miljø med varierende opgaver
* Du har mulighed for at arbejde ca. 15 timer om ugen ved siden af dit studie
* Du bliver tilknyttet vores kontor i Ballerup, hvor vi forventer, at du møder fysisk op, samtidig med at jobbet kan tilpasses dit studie. Der er også mulighed for at arbejde hjemmefra.

**Mere end et studiejob**

Som Student Worker i KMD bliver du en del af et engageret netværk af studerende på tværs af virksomheden. Gennem faglige og sociale aktiviteter får du mulighed for at udvide dit netværk, dele erfaringer med andre studerende og skabe værdifulde relationer. Samtidig får du mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer og opbygge relevant erhvervserfaring i et professionelt og inspirerende arbejdsmiljø.

**Ansøgningsfrist**

Vi kalder løbende ind til samtaler, så tøv endelig ikke med at sende din ansøgning og CV til os.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning!

7e51e3e9cfe5.title: Student Assistant - Commercial Digital Transformation & Portfolio Support
7e51e3e9cfe5.description_md:
**Student Assistant - Commercial Digital Transformation & Portfolio Support**

Are you curious about how business strategy, digital technologies and AI come together to drive transformation? Would you like to gain hands-on experience working at the intersection of business and IT in a global pharmaceutical company? Then you could be our next Student Assistant in Commercial Digital Enablement at Lundbeck.

**Your new role**

As our Student Assistant, you will join our Commercial Business Partnering & Value team, where we connect business priorities with digital opportunities to support Lundbeck's commercial transformation. Working closely with our Senior Digital Business Partner and Head of Commercial Digital Enablement, you will help create structure, transparency and insights across our portfolio of digital initiatives, while engaging with commercial stakeholders across the business and colleagues from different digital and IT functions.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Portfolio overview: Help maintain an overview of our commercial digital initiatives, including priorities, progress and key dependencies.
* Value & cost tracking: Support tracking and reporting of business value, investments, costs and risks across our digital portfolio.
* Resource & portfolio coordination: Help create transparency on resource needs, maintain portfolio information and follow up with relevant stakeholders.
* Governance & management support: Contribute to presentations, analyses and decision-making materials for CDE leadership and digital governance forums, including insights on value, costs, timelines and resources.
* Data quality & continuous improvement: Maintain trackers and decision logs, ensure information is accurate and up to date, and help improve our templates, dashboards and ways of working.
* Business partnering & project support: Support our business partnering activities and, as you develop in the role, contribute to digital transformation projects in collaboration with commercial stakeholders.

You will have the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, gain hands-on experience and develop your skills in areas such as business partnering, digital transformation, portfolio management and stakeholder engagement. As you grow into the role, you will gradually take on more responsibility and have the opportunity to contribute directly to projects that support Lundbeck's commercial business.

We believe in learning by doing, and we will support you in developing your skills and exploring your interests along the way.

The position is approximately 20 hours per week, typically spread across 2–3 days. Working hours will be agreed upon together, with flexibility to accommodate your studies and exam periods.

 

**Your future team**

 

You will join Commercial Digital Enablement (CDE), part of Enterprise Digital Enablement (EDE) at Lundbeck. Our team acts as a bridge between Lundbeck's commercial business and IT, helping translate business needs into digital solutions that create measurable value.

 

We work closely with commercial stakeholders across global functions and markets, to support initiatives spanning digital platforms, data, AI and customer engagement.

 

You will be part of our Business Partnering & Value team, working closely with our Senior Digital Business Partner and Head of Commercial Digital Enablement. You will also collaborate with experienced colleagues across digital strategy, architecture and delivery.

 

We offer a supportive learning environment where you are encouraged to ask questions, share ideas and take initiative. You will gain exposure to different aspects of digital transformation and have the opportunity to shape your role as your skills and interests develop.

 

The position is based in Copenhagen (Valby), Denmark.

 

**What you bring to the team**

We are looking for a motivated and curious student who combines strong analytical and organisational skills with a genuine interest in business and digital transformation. You enjoy taking initiative, working with others and learning new things, and you are eager to apply and further develop your skills in a professional environment.

We imagine that you:

* Are enrolled in a relevant university programme, such as business administration, economics, digital business, IT or a related field.
* Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to structure information and communicate insights clearly.
* Are proactive, structured and detail-oriented, with a sense of ownership and responsibility for your tasks.
* Have good communication skills in English and enjoy collaborating with different stakeholders.

Experience with PowerPoint and Excel is an advantage, but not a requirement. More importantly, you are comfortable working with information, have an interest in developing your technical and business skills, and are motivated to learn.

We value both the skills you bring and your potential to grow. With the right mindset, curiosity and willingness to take on new challenges, you will have plenty of opportunities to develop and make an impact.

**Our promise to you**

Lundbeck offers an inspiring workplace and innovative culture, where our curiosity, accountability and adaptability enable us to transform lives. We want to go faster and further on addressing the big unmet needs of people living with brain disorders. We offer rewarding careers with a mix of exciting tasks and development opportunities that are balanced with initiatives focused on your well-being.

We need every brain in the game, and at Lundbeck, we are committed to building a workforce that is as diverse as the people we serve. Read more about our commitment at [www.lundbeck.com/global/about-us/our-commitment/diversity-and-inclusion](http://www.lundbeck.com/global/about-us/our-commitment/diversity-and-inclusion).

At Lundbeck, we are committed to fair and transparent pay. Please note that the final hourly rate will be based on relevant qualifications, skills, competencies, level of proficiency, and internal pay equity.

**Apply now**

Can you see yourself in this role? We want to hear from you. Does this sound like your dream job, but you’re not sure if you meet all the requirements? We still want to hear from you!

Upload your CV and include a few lines about your motivation for applying. We ask you not to include a photo or personal information that does not relate to your professional experience.

If you have questions, please contact Emilie Steensen Blicher, EMBC@lundbeck.com

Applications must be received by Friday 13 November 2026.

Learn more about us at [www.lundbeck.com](http://www.lundbeck.com/), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/lundbeck/) or Instagram (@h\_lundbeck).

#EveryBrainInTheGame

***This job ad is intended for individuals seeking a career opportunity with Lundbeck.**We engage with recruitment and search firms where needed on the basis of a written agreement, and we do not accept unsolicited requests of any kind. If you work as a recruitment consultant, you are kindly instructed to refrain from contacting Lundbeck or the hiring manager directly with suggested candidates. If you violate this policy, you do so at your own risk and for your own account, and Lundbeck will not assume any liability nor pay any associated fees resulting from such violation.*

77c9a1a2e5a8.title: Ambitiøs og struktureret student til EU-teamet i Jura og EU
77c9a1a2e5a8.description_md:
*Interesserer du dig for EU-politik, internationale forhold og kommunerne? Arbejder du struktureret og selvstændigt? Så er det måske dig, vi søger som student i EU-teamet i KL.*

EU-teamet koordinerer KL’s interessevaretagelsesindsats over for EU-institutionerne, betjener KL’s Internationale udvalg og assisterer KL’s politikere i forhold til deres mødeaktiviteter bl.a. i EU’s Regionsudvalg og i Europarådets Kongres for lokale og regionale myndigheder.

I EU-teamet vil du få erfaring med politisk sekretariatsbetjening, interessevaretagelse og indsigt i EU. EU-teamets arbejde foregår både i KL-huset i København og på KL's Bruxelleskontor. EU-studenten er tilknyttet EU-teamets arbejde i København.

Jura og EU består desuden af et kommunalretligt team og et ansættelsesretligt team.

**Din hverdag i KL**

Som student i KL bliver du en del af en interesseorganisation med politisk gennemslagskraft og med indflydelse på samfundsudviklingen. Vi tilbyder både ansvar og gode udviklingsmuligheder.

Som student i EU-teamet skal du blandt andet:

* Bidrage til sekretariatsbetjeningen samt forberede mødemateriale til KL's politikere
* Formidle viden om KL's EU-interessevaretagelse til kommunerne, fx via KL’s hjemmeside og KL’s EU-nyhedsbrev
* Bidrage til KL's EU-interessevaretagelse med fx udarbejdelse af baggrundsnotater og analyser
* Løse diverse ad hoc og administrative opgaver.

**Din profil**

Du er studerende på en samfundsvidenskabelig uddannelse, fx cand.scient.pol./cand.scient.adm. Du har minimum gennemført to år af dit studie.

Det er vigtigt, at du:

* er struktureret, grundig og har sans for detaljen
* tager selvstændigt ansvar for dine arbejdsopgaver
* er god til at kommunikere skriftligt både på dansk og engelsk, fx formidling af nyheder om EU
* har interesse for politisk sekretariatsbetjening
* er en engageret holdspiller, der er åben for mange typer opgaver både analytiske og praktiske.

**Det praktiske**

Lyder studenterstillingen som noget for dig, så send os din ansøgning og cv, så vi har den senest fredag den 13. november 2026.

Vi forventer at holde samtaler onsdag den 18. november 2026.

Der vil være opstart i starten af januar 2027. Dette aftales nærmere.

Arbejdstiden er i gennemsnit 15 timer om ugen og kan tilpasses i forhold til dit studie.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst.

For den rette kandidat kan der efter ca. et års ansættelse være mulighed for et praktikophold på KL's Bruxelleskontor.

**Har du spørgsmål til stillingen?**

Vil du vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte EU-teamleder Annemette Frost, tlf. 33 70 34 77 – [asf@kl.dk](mailto:asf@kl.dk).

734bc424754a.title: Piccolo/Piccoline – deltid
734bc424754a.description_md:
Som piccolo/piccoline bliver du en vigtig del af hverdagen på projektkontoret. Du er med til at sikre, at kontoret fungerer, at medarbejdere og gæster føler sig velkomne, og at de praktiske opgaver bliver løst effektivt og professionelt. Stillingen er på ca. 15 timer om ugen fordelt på 2-3 hverdage.

**En varieret hverdag med mange forskellige opgaver**
Du får en bred rolle med mange forskellige opgaver og kontaktflader. Nogle dage handler om at holde styr på kontorets daglige drift, mens andre byder på koordinering af møder og arrangementer.

Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:

* Sørge for, at kontoret fremstår pænt, ryddeligt og præsentabelt
* Bestille forplejning, kontorartikler og øvrige forbrugsvarer samt sikre, at lageret er fyldt op
* Fejlmelde IT-udstyr og koordinere med IT-support ved tekniske problemer
* Bestille og koordinere serviceydelser som VVS, elektriker, vintertjeneste og vinduespudsning efter behov
* Bestille adgangskort og koordinere adgang for entreprenører og samarbejdspartnere
* Opdatere mødebookingark, ferielister og årshjul
* Hjælpe med gæstebesøg, møder, fejringer og arrangementer, herunder bestilling af forplejning, blomster og pynt

**Du får tingene til at fungere**
Vi søger en kollega, der motiveres af at skabe gode rammer på kontoret og trives i en koordinerende funktion. Du er imødekommende, hjælpsom og tager naturligt ansvar for de opgaver, der opstår i løbet af dagen.

Du kan fx være studerende, holde sabbatår eller bare være på udkig efter et godt deltidsjob. Din baggrund er mindre vigtig. Det vigtigste er, at du får tingene til at spille i en travl hverdag.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

• Trives med praktiske og varierende opgaver og løser opgaverne effektivt 
• Er mødestabil, serviceminded og kan lide at give andre en god oplevelse 
• Har god erfaring med almindelige IT-værktøjer, herunder Outlook og Excel 
• Bidrager positivt til samarbejdet og det gode arbejdsmiljø på projektkontoret

**Dygtige kolleger er klar til at byde dig velkommen**
Du bliver ansat i Projekt- & Ledelsessupport og refererer til sektionslederen, mens din daglige arbejdsplads er projektkontoret for Svanemøllens Skybrudstunnel i Nordhavn, hvor du bliver en del af hverdagen i projektgruppen.

Du kan læse mere om vores medarbejdergoder [her](https://www.hofor.dk/om-hofor/job/medarbejdergoder/)

**Sådan bliver du vores kollega**
Er du klar til nye muligheder, ser vi frem til at høre fra dig senest den 22. november 2026. Vi vil gerne gøre det nemt for dig at søge, så du skal ikke skrive en traditionel ansøgning. Send i stedet dit CV, hvor du kort sætter ord på din motivation for at søge stillingen. Du kan finde inspiration til at skrive et motiveret CV [her](https://www.hofor.dk/om-hofor/job/rekrutteringsprocessen/)

Processen består af 1. samtalerunde og vi afholder 1. samtaler i uge 49.

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte sektionsleder Tanja Bergmann på tanb@hofor.dk.

Søg stillingen ved at klikke på ”Søg stillingen”.

9f217c2a3b75.title: Student position in Credit Rating and ESG Analysis
9f217c2a3b75.description_md:
# Student position in Credit Rating and ESG Analysis

København S, DK, 2300

**Job ID: 7001**

We are looking for a Student with strong analytical skills to support with credit rating and other ad hoc tasks in the credit process – A splendid opportunity to get insight into the fundamentals for handling corporate customers in Nordea. Location will be at our Danish headquarters at Grønjordsvej in Copenhagen.

**About our team**

Meet the Credit, Rating & ESG Analysis team. We assess credit risk and identify early warning signals to help prevent unexpected losses across individual customer engagements within traditional corporates, agriculture and real estate. We are part of the Nordic Credit Risk & ESG Analysis organisation, with 320 employees in Group Credit Management - almost 70 of whom are based in Denmark.

We take pride in onboarding and supporting new colleagues, and we work together in an open, respectful tone with genuine interest in one another.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.  

**What you’ll be doing**

**Main responsibilities in this role:**

* Assess credit risk for specific corporate customers - initially focusing on Tenant Owned Associations ("Andelsboligforeninger")
* Deliver high-quality analyses that enable an efficient credit process and strong customer experiences
* Identify early warning signals and help shape the right credit strategy in collaboration with the value chain
* Work closely with internal stakeholders across the value chain, including relationship managers and decision-makers
* Contribute to the team’s continuous improvement and development
* Support with ad hoc tasks related to the credit process

**Who you are**

This role is a great fit if you have strong financial analytical skills and are motivated to take an active part in the credit process. You can work independently while also ensuring close collaboration within the team and with key stakeholders. If you enjoy tackling challenges and are committed to both personal and professional development, we have plenty to offer.

The position is 15-20 hours per week.

**Your background and skills include:**

* Financial analysis and accounting
* Danish written and spoken
* English also important as all guidelines are in English
* Basic excel skills

**It would be ideal if you also:**

* Have a positive mindset
* Relate easily with stakeholders

**What we offer**

People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

20916be130d3.title: Student Assistant, S&OP/IBP - Global Supply Chain Planning & Analytics
20916be130d3.description_md:
*Are you analytical, detail-oriented, and eager to gain hands-on experience in global supply chain planning? Do you enjoy working with data, generating insights, and supporting business decision-making?*

Pandora is currently looking for a Student Assistant to join our S&OP/IBP team within Global Supply Chain. In this role, you will contribute to the monthly planning cycle and metal hedging process through data consolidation, analysis, reporting, and stakeholder coordination.

You will take ownership of selected recurring deliverables and support the improvement of planning tools, inventory management, data quality, and processes across Global Supply Chain.

This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience with Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), Integrated Business Planning (IBP), supply chain analytics, inventory planning, and process improvement in one of the world's leading jewellery brands. Working closely with stakeholders across Pandora's global organization, you will gain valuable insight into how data, planning, and cross-functional collaboration drive operational and commercial decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Consolidate data and prepare reports, analyses, and meeting materials for the monthly S&OP/IBP cycle.
* Take ownership of selected recurring reports and data-consolidation activities.
* Develop and maintain planning tools, dashboards, KPIs, and inventory projections with guidance from the team.
* Support the metal hedging process by consolidating forecasts, conducting analyses, preparing decision materials, and coordinating stakeholder input.
* Analyze inventory, production, and supply chain performance and translate data into clear business insights.
* Coordinate meeting agendas, materials, stakeholder input, action tracking, and follow-up.
* Contribute to improvements in planning processes, reporting, automation, and data quality.
* Support ad hoc analyses and tasks as required.

**Your Team**

You will join the S&OP/IBP team within Global Supply Chain and report to the S&OP/IBP Manager. The team collaborates closely with stakeholders across Crafting & Supply, Global Treasury, and other areas within Global Supply Chain to support planning, decision-making, and business performance.

As part of the team, you will gain first-hand experience with how integrated planning processes connect demand, supply, inventory, and financial considerations across a global organization.

**Qualifications**

* Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree within Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, Data Science, Business Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
* Ideally have at least one year remaining of your studies.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, Power Query, and working with large datasets.
* Comfortable working with data and translating it into meaningful insights.
* Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken.
* Experience with BI, ERP, MRP, WMS, reporting, or planning tools is considered an advantage.
* Previous full-time work experience is not required. Relevant experience gained through student employment, internships, university projects, or similar activities is considered an advantage.
* An interest in automation, digitalization, and AI-enabled planning processes is considered a plus.

**Personal Competencies**

* Analytical and curious, with a strong interest in supply chain planning, S&OP, and Integrated Business Planning.
* Structured and detail-oriented in your approach to tasks and problem-solving.
* Proactive and eager to learn, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Comfortable working independently and taking responsibility for assigned deliverables.
* A clear and confident communicator.
* Collaborative and confident working with stakeholders across different functions and markets.
* Able to balance attention to detail with an understanding of the bigger picture.

**You Will Get**

* Hands-on experience with S&OP, Integrated Business Planning, and global supply chain processes.
* Opportunities to work with data consolidation, reporting, analysis, and inventory planning.
* Insight into the metal hedging process and the coordination of forecasts and stakeholder input.
* Exposure to cross-functional collaboration across Global Supply Chain, Crafting & Supply, and Global Treasury.
* Opportunities to develop your Excel, analytical, and business communication skills.
* Experience taking ownership of recurring reports and deliverables.
* The opportunity to contribute to improvements in planning processes, automation, reporting, and data quality.

**Additional Information**

* You are expected to work approximately 15-20 hours per week on average (less during exam periods and more when possible).
* The role is based at Pandora's Global Office in Copenhagen and requires physical presence.
* You must be a current student to apply.
* Start date: As soon as possible.

**Did We Get Your Attention?**

We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you would like to become part of Pandora's future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site at [Pandora Group](https://www.linkedin.com/safety/go/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Epandoragroup%2Ecom%2F&urlhash=qtQ9&mt=laQ3r8Tla7Ujg-UG-jP_uP0VqDqUnVhRxyNsMn0-fzjOix70wnh7jR_e8W-4F2ESK7hjtHv9il9NYOilCza7fkAg7aM&isSdui=true).

**Icing on the Cake**

You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora**

Pandora is the world’s largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores. Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.
